artifacts.summary: Implementation plan with 4 phases to fill 10 sorry instances in intuitionistic tableau soundness proofs

memory_candidates.content: Intuitionistic tableau soundness proofs require a MonotoneEdges invariant (worldOf monotone w.r.t. edge-based accessibility) threaded through the expansion loop induction. This invariant survives Function.update at F(imp) world-creation steps because fresh labels are > all existing branch labels, and the semantic witness w' satisfies worldOf(parentLabel) <= w'. The classical tableau does not need this invariant because classical logic has no world-creation rules. The pattern is: universally quantify worldOf in the conclusion, thread MonotoneEdges as an additional hypothesis alongside branch satisfiability, and use monotoneEdges_update to maintain it across world-creation steps.
